title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on Printing and Distributing the "Measures for Carrying Out Pilot Work on Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases"
keywords_en: Regarding the Handling of Criminal Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court   Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the Measures for Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases

SF TZ [2017] No. 106

The High People's Courts and the Judicial Departments (Bureaus) of Beijing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Anhui, Henan, Guangdong, Sichuan, and Shaanxi Provinces (Municipalities directly under the Central Government):

In order to advance the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trial, strengthen judicial protection of human rights, promote judicial fairness, and give full play to the role of lawyers in criminal defense during trial, the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice have formulated the "Measures for Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases", which are hereby issued. All pilot provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government) shall fully recognize the important significance of carrying out the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases, and advance the pilot work actively and steadily. It is necessary to strengthen coordination and cooperation, regularly communicate work situations, and jointly promote the pilot work. It is necessary to strengthen work guidance and supervision, closely monitor the progress of the pilot work, promptly identify and resolve problems, and ensure the in-depth and effective implementation of the pilot work. Reports on the progress of the pilot work shall be submitted to the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice respectively every six months.

October 9, 2017

Measures for Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases

In order to advance the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trial, strengthen judicial protection of human rights, promote judicial fairness, and give full play to the role of lawyers in criminal defense during trial, and to carry out the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense at the trial stage of criminal cases, these Measures are formulated in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law and other laws and regulations, and in light of the actual judicial work.

Article 1 A defendant has the right to obtain a defense. The People's Court and the judicial administrative organs shall ensure the defense rights and other litigation rights legally enjoyed by the defendant and his defense lawyer.

Article 2 In addition to exercising the right of defense by himself, a defendant has the right to entrust a lawyer as his defender.

If a defendant falls under the circumstances provided for in Articles 34 and 267 of the Criminal Procedure Law where defense should be notified, and has not entrusted a defender, the People's Court shall notify a legal aid institution to assign a lawyer to provide him with defense.

Except as provided in the preceding paragraph, in other cases tried under ordinary procedures at first instance, cases at second instance, and cases tried under procedures for trial supervision, if the defendant has not entrusted a defender, the People's Court shall notify a legal aid institution to assign a lawyer to provide him with defense.

In cases tried under summary procedures or fast-track sentencing procedures, if the defendant has no defender, the People's Court shall notify a duty lawyer stationed by a legal aid institution to provide him with legal assistance.

Before a lawyer assigned by a legal aid institution or entrusted by the defendant provides defense for the defendant, the defendant and his close relatives may request legal assistance, and the People's Court shall notify a duty lawyer stationed by a legal aid institution to provide him with legal assistance.

Article 3 Within three days from the date of accepting the case, the People's Court shall inform the defendant that he has the right to entrust a defender and to obtain legal assistance from a duty lawyer. If the defendant falls under the circumstances provided for in paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 2 of these Measures, the People's Court shall inform him that if he does not entrust a defender, it will notify a legal aid institution to assign a lawyer to provide him with defense.

Article 4 Where the People's Court issues a notice of defense, it shall submit to the legal aid institution the official letter of notice of defense along with copies or duplicates of the indictment, judgment, protest letter, or notification of case acceptance upon appeal or petition.

The official letter of notice of defense shall include the defendant's name, the alleged crime, the place of detention or residence, the reason for the notice of defense, the name and contact information of the judicial personnel, etc.; if the trial date has been set, the official letter of notice of defense shall include the time and place of the trial.

Article 5 The legal aid institution shall, within three days from the date of receiving the official letter of notice of defense or making a decision to grant legal aid, determine the lawyer to undertake the case and notify the People's Court by letter.

The official letter of legal aid issued by the legal aid institution shall include the name of the defense lawyer, the unit to which he belongs, and contact information.

If the content of the official letter of notice of defense from the People's Court is incomplete or the materials for the notice of defense are incomplete, the legal aid institution shall request the People's Court to supplement them; if the People's Court fails to supplement the materials specified in paragraph 1 of Article 4 of these Measures fifteen days before the trial, which may affect the performance of duties by the defense lawyer, the legal aid institution may request the People's Court to change the trial date.

Article 6 In cases where notice of defense should be given as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 2 of these Measures, if the defendant refuses the lawyer assigned by the legal aid institution as his defender, the People's Court shall ascertain the reason for the refusal; if there is a legitimate reason, it shall permit it, and at the same time inform the defendant that he must entrust another defender. If the defendant does not entrust another defender, the People's Court shall promptly notify the legal aid institution to assign another lawyer to provide him with defense.

In cases where notice of defense should be given as provided in paragraph 3 of Article 2 of these Measures, if the defendant insists on defending himself and refuses the lawyer assigned by the legal aid institution as his defender, and the People's Court permits it, the legal aid institution shall make a decision to terminate the legal aid; if the defendant requests a change of lawyer for a legitimate reason, the legal aid institution shall assign another lawyer to provide him with defense.

Article 7 Judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations shall coordinate and allocate lawyer resources to provide guarantees for the implementation of legal aid work. If local lawyer resources are insufficient to meet the needs of the work, the judicial administrative organ may apply to the judicial administrative organ at the next higher level for necessary support.

Localities with conditions may establish a pool of criminal defense lawyers to support the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases.

Article 8 A multi-level funding guarantee mechanism shall be established to strengthen the funding guarantee for legal aid, ensuring that the level of funding guarantee meets the needs of carrying out the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases.

Judicial administrative organs shall coordinate with financial departments to reasonably determine and appropriately increase the case handling subsidy standards based on factors such as the cost of lawyers undertaking criminal cases, basic labor fees, service quality, and case difficulty, and pay them in full and on time.

Localities with conditions may carry out government procurement of legal aid services.

Article 9 Exploration shall be made into having legal aid recipients share part of the legal aid costs.

The conditions, procedures, and standards for sharing costs of legal aid shall be determined by provincial judicial administrative organs based on factors such as the local economic development level, resident income status, and case handling subsidy standards.

Article 10 Judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations shall encourage and support lawyers in conducting criminal defense work, organize senior backbone lawyers to handle criminal legal aid cases, give play to the exemplary role of outstanding lawyers in the field of criminal defense, organize special training on criminal defense, carry out selection and commendation activities for outstanding criminal defense lawyers, recommend outstanding criminal defense lawyers for public selection as legislative workers, judges, and prosecutors, establish incentive mechanisms for lawyers to conduct criminal defense work, and fully mobilize the enthusiasm of lawyers to participate in criminal defense work.

Article 11 If a court of second instance discovers that the court of first instance failed to perform its duty of notice of defense, resulting in the defendant not receiving a lawyer's defense during the trial, it shall find that the circumstances provided for in Article 227, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Procedure Law are met, and shall rule to quash the original judgment and remand the case to the original trial court for retrial.

Article 12 If the People's Court fails to perform its duty of notice of defense, or the legal aid institution fails to perform its duty of assigning a lawyer, resulting in the defendant not receiving a lawyer's defense during the trial, the relevant responsible persons shall be held accountable according to law.

Article 13 The People's Court shall, according to law, guarantee the defense lawyer's rights to information, application, and appeal, as well as his professional rights in matters such as meeting, reviewing case files, collecting evidence, questioning, cross-examination, and argument, and shall provide convenience for the defense lawyer to perform his duties, including consulting, extracting, and copying case file materials.

Article 14 When the People's Court makes major procedural decisions such as holding a pre-trial conference, postponing the trial, not holding a trial at second instance, or announcing a judgment, it shall promptly inform the defense lawyer according to law. The People's Court shall rely on the China Trial Procedure Information Disclosure Website to promptly disclose the procedural information of the case to the defense lawyer.

Article 15 If a defense lawyer requests to review case files, the People's Court shall arrange for the defense lawyer to review the case files at that time; if it cannot be arranged at that time, it shall explain the reasons to the defense lawyer and arrange for the review within three working days after the cause preventing the review is eliminated, and shall not restrict the reasonable number and time of reviews by the defense lawyer. Localities with conditions may establish a case file review appointment platform, promote electronic case file review, and allow the copying and downloading of materials. If the defense lawyer copies case file materials, the People's Court shall only charge the cost of materials. The costs of copying case file materials by lawyers assigned by legal aid institutions shall be exempted or reduced.

A defense lawyer may bring one or two lawyer assistants to assist in reviewing case files, and the People's Court shall verify the identities of the lawyer assistants. If a lawyer finds that case file materials are incomplete or unclear, the People's Court shall promptly arrange for verification and supplementation.

Article 16 If a defense lawyer applies to the People's Court for the collection and procurement of evidence, the People's Court shall, within three days, make a decision on whether to approve and notify the defense lawyer. If the People's Court approves, it shall promptly collect and procure the relevant evidence. If the People's Court does not approve, it shall state the reasons; if the defense lawyer requests a written reply, it shall provide the reasons in writing.

Article 17 If a defendant or defense lawyer applies for the court to notify a witness, expert evaluator, or person with specialized knowledge to testify in court, the court shall approve if it deems it necessary; if the court does not approve, it shall state the reasons in writing to the defendant and the defense lawyer.

Article 18 The People's Court shall give due consideration to the lawyer's defense opinions; if the defense opinions submitted by the lawyer according to law are not adopted, a targeted analysis shall be made and the reasons for non-adoption shall be explained.

Article 19 The People's Court, judicial administrative organs, and lawyers associations shall establish and improve a rapid handling mechanism for protecting lawyers' professional rights, and smooth the channels for lawyers to seek remedies for their professional rights. The Supervisory Department of the People's Court is responsible for receiving lawyer complaints. The People's Court shall publicly disclose on its official website and in its office premises the name, telephone number, and address for letters and visits of the receiving institution, and promptly provide feedback on the results of investigation and handling, so as to effectively enhance the timeliness and effectiveness of protecting lawyers' professional rights and ensure that lawyers' professional rights are not infringed upon.

Article 20 A defense lawyer shall adhere to taking facts as the basis and the law as the criterion, perform the duties of defense and representation in a lawful, standardized, and honest manner, be diligent and responsible, continuously improve the quality and level of defense work, effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, and promote judicial fairness.

At the trial stage, a lawyer who undertakes a criminal legal aid case assigned by a legal aid institution shall meet with the defendant and make a meeting record, review the case files and copy the main case file materials.

For cases tried in court by the People's Court, the defense lawyer shall make preparations before the trial; participate in all trial activities, fully cross-examine and make statements; submit specific and targeted defense opinions and submit a written defense opinion to the People's Court. For cases not tried in court by the People's Court, the defense lawyer shall submit a written defense opinion to the People's Court within ten days from the date of receiving the notice of not holding a trial.

Article 21 A defense lawyer shall abide by laws and regulations, professional conduct standards, and court discipline; shall not incite, abet, or organize the defendant's guardians, close relatives, etc. to express demands by illegal means; shall not maliciously hype cases, or engage in distorted or misleading publicity or comments about cases; shall not disclose or disseminate information or materials of cases not tried in public, or important case information or evidence materials learned during the handling of the case, in violation of regulations; shall not improperly meet with the defendant or abet the defendant to retract his confession; shall not assist the defendant to conceal, destroy, or fabricate evidence or collude in confessions, or threaten or induce witnesses to give false testimony, or engage in other acts that interfere with the litigation activities of judicial organs.

Article 22 Judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations shall provide guidance and supervision for law firms and lawyers conducting criminal defense work, and implement rewards and disciplinary actions based on the performance of legal aid obligations by law firms and lawyers.

Legal aid institutions and law firms shall provide guidance and supervision for defense lawyers in their criminal defense activities, promoting defense lawyers to perform their defense duties according to law.

If, during the handling of a case, the People's Court discovers that a defense lawyer has engaged in illegal acts or acts violating professional ethics or professional discipline, it shall promptly make judicial suggestions to the judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations, and shall secure and hand over relevant evidence materials and provide necessary assistance. After verification by the judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations, the results shall be promptly notified to the suggesting organ.

Article 23 The People's Court and judicial administrative organs shall strengthen coordination, do a good job of handover work regarding duty lawyers, conveying requests for entrusted defense, and notices of defense, explore the establishment of an online platform for work handover, establish a regular consultation and notification mechanism, promptly communicate situations, coordinate and resolve problems, and promote the effective implementation of the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases.

Article 24 For handling criminal cases, if these Measures have provisions, they shall be followed; if these Measures have no provisions, the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Lawyers Law of the People's Republic of China, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Regulations on Legal Aid, the Provisions on the Procedures for Handling Legal Aid Cases, the Provisions on Criminal Procedure Legal Aid Work, the Provisions on Lawfully Protecting Lawyers' Professional Rights, and other laws, regulations, judicial interpretations, rules, and normative documents shall be followed.

Article 25 These Measures shall be tried for one year from the date of issuance.

Article 26 These Measures shall be tried in Beijing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Anhui, Henan, Guangdong, Sichuan, and Shaanxi Provinces (Municipalities directly under the Central Government). Pilot provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government) may carry out the pilot work within the entire province (municipality) or in selected areas.
